pr_title: Fix access check for org-level project
pr_body:
Fix #25934

Add `ignoreGlobal` parameter to `reqUnitAccess` and only check global disabled units when `ignoreGlobal` is true. So the org-level projects and user-level projects won't be affected by global disabled `repo.projects` unit.

issue_context.title: If repo.projects unit is disabled, it's still shown in user profile page
issue_context.body:
### Description

I'm using the DISABLE_REPO_UNITS to disable the projects unit. In most places, the project links are removed but in the user profile, the link still exists.

![image](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/93120661/2f238a16-ba60-4b25-b800-6db9985e5585)

Clicking on that, leads to a 404 page



### Screenshots

![image](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/93120661/168d754e-9079-4bb2-9f14-782336ece1fb)

### Gitea Version

1.20

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No

### Operating System

Docker on Debian

### Browser Version

Chrome 114
comments:
When `repo.projects` is disabled, clicking links of user-level projects and org-level projects leads to 404 page.
Since `DISABLED_REPO_UNITS` is used to control repo-level units, I think we need to fix the project unit checks (including `reqUnitAccess(unit.TypeProjects, ...)` and `repo.MustEnableProjects`) for user/org level projects.

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/24b49bcf6615a05cecb77568a1c22ff982141918/routers/web/web.go#L833-L864
